verses.he: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃
verses.ar: وَكَلَّمَ ٱلرَّبُّ مُوسَى قَائِلًا:
verses.en: And the LORD spoke unto Moses, saying:
verses.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.web: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.he: דַּבֵּ֞ר אֶל־בְּנֵ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ וְאָמַרְתָּ֣ אֲלֵהֶ֔ם אִ֕ישׁ כִּ֥י יַפְלִ֖א נֶ֑דֶר בְּעֶרְכְּךָ֥ נְפָשֹׁ֖ת לַֽיהוָֽה׃
verses.ar: «كَلِّمْ بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ وَقُلْ لَهُمْ: إِذَا أَفْرَزَ إِنْسَانٌ نَذْرًا حَسَبَ تَقْوِيمِكَ نُفُوسًا لِلرَّبِّ،
verses.en: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them: When a man shall clearly utter a vow of persons unto the LORD, according to thy valuation,
verses.kjv: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When a man shall make a singular vow, the persons [shall be] for the LORD by thy estimation.
verses.web: “Speak to the children of Israel, and say to them, ‘When a man consecrates a person to Yahweh in a vow, according to your valuation,

verses.he: וְהָיָ֤ה עֶרְכְּךָ֙ הַזָּכָ֔ר מִבֶּן֙ עֶשְׂרִ֣ים שָׁנָ֔ה וְעַ֖ד בֶּן־שִׁשִּׁ֣ים שָׁנָ֑ה וְהָיָ֣ה עֶרְכְּךָ֗ חֲמִשִּׁ֛ים שֶׁ֥קֶל כֶּ֖סֶף בְּשֶׁ֥קֶל הַקֹּֽדֶשׁ׃
verses.ar: فَإِنْ كَانَ تَقْوِيمُكَ لِذَكَرٍ مِنِ ٱبْنِ عِشْرِينَ سَنَةً إِلَى ٱبْنِ سِتِّينَ سَنَةً، يَكُونُ تَقْوِيمُكَ خَمْسِينَ شَاقِلَ فِضَّةٍ عَلَى شَاقِلِ ٱلْمَقْدِسِ.
verses.en: then thy valuation shall be for the male from twenty years old even unto sixty years old, even thy valuation shall be fifty shekels of silver, after the shekel of the sanctuary.
verses.kjv: And thy estimation shall be of the male from twenty years old even unto sixty years old, even thy estimation shall be fifty shekels of silver, after the shekel of the sanctuary.
verses.web: your valuation of a male from twenty years old to sixty years old shall be fifty shekels of silver, according to the shekel of the sanctuary.

verses.he: וְאִם־נְקֵבָ֖ה הִ֑וא וְהָיָ֥ה עֶרְכְּךָ֖ שְׁלֹשִׁ֥ים שָֽׁקֶל׃
verses.ar: وَإِنْ كَانَ أُنْثَى يَكُونُ تَقْوِيمُكَ ثَلَاثِينَ شَاقِلًا.
verses.en: And if it be a female, then thy valuation shall be thirty shekels.
verses.kjv: And if it [be] a female, then thy estimation shall be thirty shekels.
verses.web: If she is a female, then your valuation shall be thirty shekels.

verses.he: וְאִ֨ם מִבֶּן־חָמֵ֜שׁ שָׁנִ֗ים וְעַד֙ בֶּן־עֶשְׂרִ֣ים שָׁנָ֔ה וְהָיָ֧ה עֶרְכְּךָ֛ הַזָּכָ֖ר עֶשְׂרִ֣ים שְׁקָלִ֑ים וְלַנְּקֵבָ֖ה עֲשֶׂ֥רֶת שְׁקָלִֽים׃
verses.ar: وَإِنْ كَانَ مِنِ ٱبْنِ خَمْسِ سِنِينَ إِلَى ٱبْنِ عِشْرِينَ سَنَةً يَكُونُ تَقْوِيمُكَ لِذَكَرٍ عِشْرِينَ شَاقِلًا، وَلِأُنْثَى عَشَرَةَ شَوَاقِلَ.
verses.en: And if it be from five years old even unto twenty years old, then thy valuation shall be for the male twenty shekels, and for the female ten shekels.
verses.kjv: And if [it be] from five years old even unto twenty years old, then thy estimation shall be of the male twenty shekels, and for the female ten shekels.
verses.web: If the person is from five years old to twenty years old, then your valuation shall be for a male twenty shekels, and for a female ten shekels.

verses.he: וְאִ֣ם מִבֶּן־חֹ֗דֶשׁ וְעַד֙ בֶּן־חָמֵ֣שׁ שָׁנִ֔ים וְהָיָ֤ה עֶרְכְּךָ֙ הַזָּכָ֔ר חֲמִשָּׁ֥ה שְׁקָלִ֖ים כָּ֑סֶף וְלַנְּקֵבָ֣ה עֶרְכְּךָ֔ שְׁלֹ֥שֶׁת שְׁקָלִ֖ים כָּֽסֶף׃
verses.ar: وَإِنْ كَانَ مِنِ ٱبْنِ شَهْرٍ إِلَى ٱبْنِ خَمْسِ سِنِينَ يَكُونُ تَقْوِيمُكَ لِذَكَرٍ خَمْسَةَ شَوَاقِلِ فِضَّةٍ، وَلِأُنْثَى يَكُونُ تَقْوِيمُكَ ثَلَاثَةَ شَوَاقِلِ فِضَّةٍ.
verses.en: And if it be from a month old even unto five years old, then thy valuation shall be for the male five shekels of silver, and for the female thy valuation shall be three shekels of silver.
verses.kjv: And if [it be] from a month old even unto five years old, then thy estimation shall be of the male five shekels of silver, and for the female thy estimation [shall be] three shekels of silver.
verses.web: If the person is from a month old to five years old, then your valuation shall be for a male five shekels of silver, and for a female your valuation shall be three shekels of silver.

verses.he: וְ֠אִם מִבֶּן־שִׁשִּׁ֨ים שָׁנָ֤ה וָמַ֙עְלָה֙ אִם־זָכָ֔ר וְהָיָ֣ה עֶרְכְּךָ֔ חֲמִשָּׁ֥ה עָשָׂ֖ר שָׁ֑קֶל וְלַנְּקֵבָ֖ה עֲשָׂרָ֥ה שְׁקָלִֽים׃
verses.ar: وَإِنْ كَانَ مِنِ ٱبْنِ سِتِّينَ سَنَةً فَصَاعِدًا فَإِنْ كَانَ ذَكَرًا يَكُونُ تَقْوِيمُكَ خَمْسَةَ عَشَرَ شَاقِلًا، وَأَمَّا لِلْأُنْثَى فَعَشَرَةَ شَوَاقِلَ.
verses.en: And if it be from sixty years old and upward: if it be a male, then thy valuation shall be fifteen shekels, and for the female ten shekels.
verses.kjv: And if [it be] from sixty years old and above; if [it be] a male, then thy estimation shall be fifteen shekels, and for the female ten shekels.
verses.web: If the person is from sixty years old and upward; if he is a male, then your valuation shall be fifteen shekels, and for a female ten shekels.

verses.he: וְאִם־מָ֥ךְ הוּא֙ מֵֽעֶרְכֶּ֔ךָ וְהֶֽעֱמִידֹו֙ לִפְנֵ֣י הַכֹּהֵ֔ן וְהֶעֱרִ֥יךְ אֹתֹ֖ו הַכֹּהֵ֑ן עַל־פִּ֗י אֲשֶׁ֤ר תַּשִּׂיג֙ יַ֣ד הַנֹּדֵ֔ר יַעֲרִיכֶ֖נּוּ הַכֹּהֵֽן׃ ס
verses.ar: وَإِنْ كَانَ فَقِيرًا عَنْ تَقْوِيمِكَ يُوقِفُهُ أَمَامَ ٱلْكَاهِنِ فَيُقَوِّمُهُ ٱلْكَاهِنُ. عَلَى قَدْرِ مَا تَنَالُ يَدُ ٱلنَّاذِرِ يُقَوِّمُهُ ٱلْكَاهِنُ.
verses.en: But if he be too poor for thy valuation, then he shall be set before the priest, and the priest shall value him; according to the means of him that vowed shall the priest value him.
verses.kjv: But if he be poorer than thy estimation, then he shall present himself before the priest, and the priest shall value him; according to his ability that vowed shall the priest value him.
verses.web: But if he is poorer than your valuation, then he shall be set before the priest, and the priest shall assign a value to him. The priest shall assign a value according to his ability to pay.

verses.he: וְאִם־בְּהֵמָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר יַקְרִ֧יבוּ מִמֶּ֛נָּה קָרְבָּ֖ן לַֽיהוָ֑ה כֹּל֩ אֲשֶׁ֨ר יִתֵּ֥ן מִמֶּ֛נּוּ לַיהוָ֖ה יִֽהְיֶה־קֹּֽדֶשׁ׃
verses.ar: «وَإِنْ كَانَ بَهِيمَةً مِمَّا يُقَرِّبُونَهُ قُرْبَانًا لِلرَّبِّ، فَكُلُّ مَا يُعْطِي مِنْهُ لِلرَّبِّ يَكُونُ قُدْسًا.
verses.en: And if it be a beast, whereof men bring an offering unto the LORD, all that any man giveth of such unto the LORD shall be holy.
verses.kjv: And if [it be] a beast, whereof men bring an offering unto the LORD, all that [any man] giveth of such unto the LORD shall be holy.
verses.web: “‘If it is an animal of which men offer an offering to Yahweh, all that any man gives of such to Yahweh becomes holy.

verses.he: לֹ֣א יַחֲלִיפֶ֗נּוּ וְלֹֽא־יָמִ֥יר אֹתֹ֛ו טֹ֥וב בְּרָ֖ע אֹו־רַ֣ע בְּטֹ֑וב וְאִם־הָמֵ֨ר יָמִ֤יר בְּהֵמָה֙ בִּבְהֵמָ֔ה וְהָֽיָה־ה֥וּא וּתְמוּרָתֹ֖ו יִֽהְיֶה־קֹּֽדֶשׁ׃
verses.ar: لَا يُغَيِّرُهُ وَلَا يُبْدِلُهُ جَيِّدًا بِرَدِيءٍ، أَوْ رَدِيئًا بِجَيِّدٍ. وَإِنْ أَبْدَلَ بَهِيمَةً بِبَهِيمَةٍ تَكُونُ هِيَ وَبَدِيلُهَا قُدْسًا.
verses.en: He shall not alter it, nor change it, a good for a bad, or a bad for a good; and if he shall at all change beast for beast, then both it and that for which it is changed shall be holy.
verses.kjv: He shall not alter it, nor change it, a good for a bad, or a bad for a good: and if he shall at all change beast for beast, then it and the exchange thereof shall be holy.
verses.web: He shall not alter it, nor exchange it, a good for a bad, or a bad for a good. If he shall at all exchange animal for animal, then both it and that for which it is exchanged shall be holy.

verses.he: וְאִם֙ כָּל־בְּהֵמָ֣ה טְמֵאָ֔ה אֲ֠שֶׁר לֹא־יַקְרִ֧יבוּ מִמֶּ֛נָּה קָרְבָּ֖ן לַֽיהוָ֑ה וְהֽ͏ֶעֱמִ֥יד אֶת־הַבְּהֵמָ֖ה לִפְנֵ֥י הַכֹּהֵֽן׃
verses.ar: وَإِنْ كَانَ بَهِيمَةً نَجِسَةً مِمَّا لَا يُقَرِّبُونَهُ قُرْبَانًا لِلرَّبِّ يُوقِفُ ٱلْبَهِيمَةَ أَمَامَ ٱلْكَاهِنِ،
verses.en: And if it be any unclean beast, of which they may not bring an offering unto the LORD, then he shall set the beast before the priest.
verses.kjv: And if [it be] any unclean beast, of which they do not offer a sacrifice unto the LORD, then he shall present the beast before the priest:
verses.web: If it is any unclean animal, of which they do not offer as an offering to Yahweh, then he shall set the animal before the priest;

verses.he: וְהֶעֱרִ֤יךְ הַכֹּהֵן֙ אֹתָ֔הּ בֵּ֥ין טֹ֖וב וּבֵ֣ין רָ֑ע כְּעֶרְכְּךָ֥ הַכֹּהֵ֖ן כֵּ֥ן יִהְיֶֽה׃
verses.ar: فَيُقَوِّمُهَا ٱلْكَاهِنُ جَيِّدَةً أَمْ رَدِيئَةً. فَحَسَبَ تَقْوِيمِكَ يَا كَاهِنُ هَكَذَا يَكُونُ.
verses.en: And the priest shall value it, whether it be good or bad; as thou the priest valuest it, so shall it be.
verses.kjv: And the priest shall value it, whether it be good or bad: as thou valuest it, [who art] the priest, so shall it be.
verses.web: and the priest shall evaluate it, whether it is good or bad. As the priest evaluates it, so it shall be.

verses.he: וְאִם־גָּאֹ֖ל יִגְאָלֶ֑נָּה וְיָסַ֥ף חֲמִישִׁתֹ֖ו עַל־עֶרְכֶּֽךָ׃
verses.ar: فَإِنْ فَكَّهَا يَزِيدُ خُمْسَهَا عَلَى تَقْوِيمِكَ.
verses.en: But if he will indeed redeem it, then he shall add the fifth part thereof unto thy valuation.
verses.kjv: But if he will at all redeem it, then he shall add a fifth [part] thereof unto thy estimation.
verses.web: But if he will indeed redeem it, then he shall add the fifth part of it to its valuation.

verses.he: וְאִ֗ישׁ כִּֽי־יַקְדִּ֨שׁ אֶת־בֵּיתֹ֥ו קֹ֙דֶשׁ֙ לַֽיהוָ֔ה וְהֶעֱרִיכֹו֙ הַכֹּהֵ֔ן בֵּ֥ין טֹ֖וב וּבֵ֣ין רָ֑ע כַּאֲשֶׁ֨ר יַעֲרִ֥יךְ אֹתֹ֛ו הַכֹּהֵ֖ן כֵּ֥ן יָקֽוּם׃
verses.ar: «وَإِذَا قَدَّسَ إِنْسَانٌ بَيْتَهُ قُدْسًا لِلرَّبِّ، يُقَوِّمُهُ ٱلْكَاهِنُ جَيِّدًا أَمْ رَدِيئًا. وَكَمَا يُقَوِّمُهُ ٱلْكَاهِنُ هَكَذَا يَقُومُ.
verses.en: And when a man shall sanctify his house to be holy unto the LORD, then the priest shall value it, whether it be good or bad; as the priest shall value it, so shall it stand.
verses.kjv: ¶ And when a man shall sanctify his house [to be] holy unto the LORD, then the priest shall estimate it, whether it be good or bad: as the priest shall estimate it, so shall it stand.
verses.web: “‘When a man dedicates his house to be holy to Yahweh, then the priest shall evaluate it, whether it is good or bad. As the priest evaluates it, so it shall stand.

verses.he: וְאִ֨ם־הַמַּקְדִּ֔ישׁ יִגְאַ֖ל אֶת־בֵּיתֹ֑ו וְ֠יָסַף חֲמִישִׁ֧ית כֶּֽסֶף־עֶרְכְּךָ֛ עָלָ֖יו וְהָ֥יָה לֹֽו׃
verses.ar: فَإِنْ كَانَ ٱلْمُقَدِّسُ يَفُكُّ بَيْتَهُ، يَزِيدُ خُمْسَ فِضَّةِ تَقْوِيمِكَ عَلَيْهِ فَيَكُونُ لَهُ.
verses.en: And if he that sanctified it will redeem his house, then he shall add the fifth part of the money of thy valuation unto it, and it shall be his.
verses.kjv: And if he that sanctified it will redeem his house, then he shall add the fifth [part] of the money of thy estimation unto it, and it shall be his.
verses.web: If he who dedicates it will redeem his house, then he shall add the fifth part of the money of your valuation to it, and it shall be his.

verses.he: וְאִ֣ם ׀ מִשְּׂדֵ֣ה אֲחֻזָּתֹ֗ו יַקְדִּ֥ישׁ אִישׁ֙ לַֽיהוָ֔ה וְהָיָ֥ה עֶרְכְּךָ֖ לְפִ֣י זַרְעֹ֑ו זֶ֚רַע חֹ֣מֶר שְׂעֹרִ֔ים בַּחֲמִשִּׁ֖ים שֶׁ֥קֶל כָּֽסֶף׃
verses.ar: وَإِنْ قَدَّسَ إِنْسَانٌ بَعْضَ حَقْلِ مُلْكِهِ لِلرَّبِّ، يَكُونُ تَقْوِيمُكَ عَلَى قَدَرِ بِذَارِهِ. بِذَارُ حُومَرٍ مِنَ ٱلشَّعِيرِ بِخَمْسِينَ شَاقِلِ فِضَّةٍ.
verses.en: And if a man shall sanctify unto the LORD part of the field of his possession, then thy valuation shall be according to the sowing thereof; the sowing of a homer of barley shall be valued at fifty shekels of silver.
verses.kjv: And if a man shall sanctify unto the LORD [some part] of a field of his possession, then thy estimation shall be according to the seed thereof: an homer of barley seed [shall be valued] at fifty shekels of silver.
verses.web: “‘If a man dedicates to Yahweh part of the field of his possession, then your valuation shall be according to the seed for it. The sowing of a homer of barley shall be valued at fifty shekels of silver.

verses.he: אִם־מִשְּׁנַ֥ת הַיֹּבֵ֖ל יַקְדִּ֣ישׁ שָׂדֵ֑הוּ כְּעֶרְכְּךָ֖ יָקֽוּם׃
verses.ar: إِنْ قَدَّسَ حَقْلَهُ مِنْ سَنَةِ ٱلْيُوبِيلِ فَحَسَبَ تَقْوِيمِكَ يَقُومُ.
verses.en: If he sanctify his field from the year of jubilee, according to thy valuation it shall stand.
verses.kjv: If he sanctify his field from the year of jubile, according to thy estimation it shall stand.
verses.web: If he dedicates his field from the Year of Jubilee, according to your valuation it shall stand.

verses.he: וְאִם־אַחַ֣ר הַיֹּבֵל֮ יַקְדִּ֣ישׁ שָׂדֵהוּ֒ וְחִשַּׁב־לֹ֨ו הַכֹּהֵ֜ן אֶת־הַכֶּ֗סֶף עַל־פִּ֤י הַשָּׁנִים֙ הַנֹּ֣ותָרֹ֔ת עַ֖ד שְׁנַ֣ת הַיֹּבֵ֑ל וְנִגְרַ֖ע מֵֽעֶרְכֶּֽךָ׃
verses.ar: وَإِنْ قَدَّسَ حَقْلَهُ بَعْدَ سَنَةِ ٱلْيُوبِيلِ يَحْسُبُ لَهُ ٱلْكَاهِنُ ٱلْفِضَّةَ عَلَى قَدَرِ ٱلسِّنِينَ ٱلْبَاقِيَةِ إِلَى سَنَةِ ٱلْيُوبِيلِ، فَيُنَقَّصُ مِنْ تَقْوِيمِكَ.
verses.en: But if he sanctify his field after the jubilee, then the priest shall reckon unto him the money according to the years that remain unto the year of jubilee, and an abatement shall be made from thy valuation.
verses.kjv: But if he sanctify his field after the jubile, then the priest shall reckon unto him the money according to the years that remain, even unto the year of the jubile, and it shall be abated from thy estimation.
verses.web: But if he dedicates his field after the Jubilee, then the priest shall reckon to him the money according to the years that remain to the Year of Jubilee; and an abatement shall be made from your valuation.

verses.he: וְאִם־גָּאֹ֤ל יִגְאַל֙ אֶת־הַשָּׂדֶ֔ה הַמַּקְדִּ֖ישׁ אֹתֹ֑ו וְ֠יָסַף חֲמִשִׁ֧ית כֶּֽסֶף־עֶרְכְּךָ֛ עָלָ֖יו וְקָ֥ם לֹֽו׃
verses.ar: فَإِنْ فَكَّ ٱلْحَقْلَ مُقَدِّسُهُ، يَزِيدُ خُمْسَ فِضَّةِ تَقْوِيمِكَ عَلَيْهِ فَيَجِبُ لَهُ.
verses.en: And if he that sanctified the field will indeed redeem it, then he shall add the fifth part of the money of thy valuation unto it, and it shall be assured to him.
verses.kjv: And if he that sanctified the field will in any wise redeem it, then he shall add the fifth [part] of the money of thy estimation unto it, and it shall be assured to him.
verses.web: If he who dedicated the field will indeed redeem it, then he shall add the fifth part of the money of your valuation to it, and it shall remain his.

verses.he: וְאִם־לֹ֤א יִגְאַל֙ אֶת־הַשָּׂדֶ֔ה וְאִם־מָכַ֥ר אֶת־הַשָּׂדֶ֖ה לְאִ֣ישׁ אַחֵ֑ר לֹ֥א יִגָּאֵ֖ל עֹֽוד׃
verses.ar: لَكِنْ إِنْ لَمْ يَفُكَّ ٱلْحَقْلَ وَبِيعَ ٱلْحَقْلُ لِإِنْسَانٍ آخَرَ لَا يُفَكُّ بَعْدُ،
verses.en: And if he will not redeem the field, or if he have sold the field to another man, it shall not be redeemed any more.
verses.kjv: And if he will not redeem the field, or if he have sold the field to another man, it shall not be redeemed any more.
verses.web: If he will not redeem the field, or if he has sold the field to another man, it shall not be redeemed any more;

verses.he: וְהָיָ֨ה הַשָּׂדֶ֜ה בְּצֵאתֹ֣ו בַיֹּבֵ֗ל קֹ֛דֶשׁ לַֽיהוָ֖ה כִּשְׂדֵ֣ה הַחֵ֑רֶם לַכֹּהֵ֖ן תִּהְיֶ֥ה אֲחֻזָּתֹֽו׃
verses.ar: بَلْ يَكُونُ ٱلْحَقْلُ عِنْدَ خُرُوجِهِ فِي ٱلْيُوبِيلِ قُدْسًا لِلرَّبِّ كَٱلْحَقْلِ ٱلْمُحَرَّمِ. لِلْكَاهِنِ يَكُونُ مُلْكُهُ.
verses.en: But the field, when it goeth out in the jubilee, shall be holy unto the LORD, as a field devoted; the possession thereof shall be the priest's.
verses.kjv: But the field, when it goeth out in the jubile, shall be holy unto the LORD, as a field devoted; the possession thereof shall be the priest’s.
verses.web: but the field, when it goes out in the Jubilee, shall be holy to Yahweh, as a devoted field. It shall be owned by the priests.

verses.he: וְאִם֙ אֶת־שְׂדֵ֣ה מִקְנָתֹ֔ו אֲשֶׁ֕ר לֹ֖א מִשְּׂדֵ֣ה אֲחֻזָּתֹ֑ו יַקְדִּ֖ישׁ לַֽיהוָֽה׃
verses.ar: «وَإِنْ قَدَّسَ لِلرَّبِّ حَقْلًا مِنْ شِرَائِهِ لَيْسَ مِنْ حُقُولِ مُلْكِهِ،
verses.en: And if he sanctify unto the LORD a field which he hath bought, which is not of the field of his possession;
verses.kjv: And if [a man] sanctify unto the LORD a field which he hath bought, which [is] not of the fields of his possession;
verses.web: “‘If he dedicates a field to Yahweh which he has bought, which is not of the field of his possession,

verses.he: וְחִשַּׁב־לֹ֣ו הַכֹּהֵ֗ן אֵ֚ת מִכְסַ֣ת הָֽעֶרְכְּךָ֔ עַ֖ד שְׁנַ֣ת הַיֹּבֵ֑ל וְנָתַ֤ן אֶת־הָעֶרְכְּךָ֙ בַּיֹּ֣ום הַה֔וּא קֹ֖דֶשׁ לַיהוָֽה׃
verses.ar: يَحْسُبُ لَهُ ٱلْكَاهِنُ مَبْلَغَ تَقْوِيمِكَ إِلَى سَنَةِ ٱلْيُوبِيلِ، فَيُعْطِي تَقْوِيمَكَ فِي ذَلِكَ ٱلْيَوْمِ قُدْسًا لِلرَّبِّ.
verses.en: then the priest shall reckon unto him the worth of thy valuation unto the year of jubilee; and he shall give thy valuation in that day, as a holy thing unto the LORD.
verses.kjv: Then the priest shall reckon unto him the worth of thy estimation, [even] unto the year of the jubile: and he shall give thine estimation in that day, [as] a holy thing unto the LORD.
verses.web: then the priest shall reckon to him the worth of your valuation up to the Year of Jubilee; and he shall give your valuation on that day, as a holy thing to Yahweh.

verses.he: בִּשְׁנַ֤ת הַיֹּובֵל֙ יָשׁ֣וּב הַשָּׂדֶ֔ה לַאֲשֶׁ֥ר קָנָ֖הוּ מֵאִתֹּ֑ו לַאֲשֶׁר־לֹ֖ו אֲחֻזַּ֥ת הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.ar: وَفِي سَنَةِ ٱلْيُوبِيلِ يَرْجِعُ ٱلْحَقْلُ إِلَى ٱلَّذِي ٱشْتَرَاهُ مِنْهُ، إِلَى ٱلَّذِي لَهُ مُلْكُ ٱلْأَرْضِ.
verses.en: In the year of jubilee the field shall return unto him of whom it was bought, even to him to whom the possession of the land belongeth.
verses.kjv: In the year of the jubile the field shall return unto him of whom it was bought, [even] to him to whom the possession of the land [did belong].
verses.web: In the Year of Jubilee the field shall return to him from whom it was bought, even to him to whom the possession of the land belongs.

verses.he: וְכָל־עֶרְכְּךָ֔ יִהְיֶ֖ה בְּשֶׁ֣קֶל הַקֹּ֑דֶשׁ עֶשְׂרִ֥ים גֵּרָ֖ה יִהְיֶ֥ה הַשָּֽׁקֶל׃ ס
verses.ar: وَكُلُّ تَقْوِيمِكَ يَكُونُ عَلَى شَاقِلِ ٱلْمَقْدِسِ. عِشْرِينَ جِيرَةً يَكُونُ ٱلشَّاقِلُ.
verses.en: And all thy valuations shall be according to the shekel of the sanctuary; twenty gerahs shall be the shekel.
verses.kjv: And all thy estimations shall be according to the shekel of the sanctuary: twenty gerahs shall be the shekel.
verses.web: All your valuations shall be according to the shekel of the sanctuary: twenty gerahs to the shekel.

verses.he: אַךְ־בְּכֹ֞ור אֲשֶׁר־יְבֻכַּ֤ר לַֽיהוָה֙ בִּבְהֵמָ֔ה לֹֽא־יַקְדִּ֥ישׁ אִ֖ישׁ אֹתֹ֑ו אִם־שֹׁ֣ור אִם־שֶׂ֔ה לַֽיהוָ֖ה הֽוּא׃
verses.ar: «لَكِنَّ ٱلْبِكْرَ ٱلَّذِي يُفْرَزُ بِكْرًا لِلرَّبِّ مِنَ ٱلْبَهَائِمِ فَلَا يُقَدِّسُهُ أَحَدٌ. ثَوْرًا كَانَ أَوْ شَاةً فَهُوَ لِلرَّبِّ.
verses.en: Howbeit the firstling among beasts, which is born as a firstling to the LORD, no man shall sanctify it; whether it be ox or sheep, it is the LORD'S.
verses.kjv: ¶ Only the firstling of the beasts, which should be the LORD’s firstling, no man shall sanctify it; whether [it be] ox, or sheep: it [is] the LORD’s.
verses.web: “‘However the firstborn among animals, which belongs to Yahweh as a firstborn, no man may dedicate, whether an ox or a sheep. It is Yahweh’s.

verses.he: וְאִ֨ם בַּבְּהֵמָ֤ה הַטְּמֵאָה֙ וּפָדָ֣ה בְעֶרְכֶּ֔ךָ וְיָסַ֥ף חֲמִשִׁתֹ֖ו עָלָ֑יו וְאִם־לֹ֥א יִגָּאֵ֖ל וְנִמְכַּ֥ר בְּעֶרְכֶּֽךָ׃
verses.ar: وَإِنْ كَانَ مِنَ ٱلْبَهَائِمِ ٱلنَّجِسَةِ يَفْدِيهِ حَسَبَ تَقْوِيمِكَ وَيَزِيدُ خُمْسَهُ عَلَيْهِ. وَإِنْ لَمْ يُفَكَّ، فَيُبَاعُ حَسَبَ تَقْوِيمِكَ.
verses.en: And if it be of an unclean beast, then he shall ransom it according to thy valuation, and shall add unto it the fifth part thereof; or if it be not redeemed, then it shall be sold according to thy valuation.
verses.kjv: And if [it be] of an unclean beast, then he shall redeem [it] according to thine estimation, and shall add a fifth [part] of it thereto: or if it be not redeemed, then it shall be sold according to thy estimation.
verses.web: If it is an unclean animal, then he shall buy it back according to your valuation, and shall add to it the fifth part of it; or if it isn’t redeemed, then it shall be sold according to your valuation.

verses.he: אַךְ־כָּל־חֵ֡רֶם אֲשֶׁ֣ר יַחֲרִם֩ אִ֨ישׁ לַֽיהוָ֜ה מִכָּל־אֲשֶׁר־לֹ֗ו מֵאָדָ֤ם וּבְהֵמָה֙ וּמִשְּׂדֵ֣ה אֲחֻזָּתֹ֔ו לֹ֥א יִמָּכֵ֖ר וְלֹ֣א יִגָּאֵ֑ל כָּל־חֵ֕רֶם קֹֽדֶשׁ־קָֽדָשִׁ֥ים ה֖וּא לַיהוָֽה׃
verses.ar: أَمَّا كُلُّ مُحَرَّمٍ يُحَرِّمُهُ إِنْسَانٌ لِلرَّبِّ مِنْ كُلِّ مَا لَهُ مِنَ ٱلنَّاسِ وَٱلْبَهَائِمِ وَمِنْ حُقُولِ مُلْكِهِ فَلَا يُبَاعُ وَلَا يُفَكُّ. إِنَّ كُلَّ مُحَرَّمٍ هُوَ قُدْسُ أَقْدَاسٍ لِلرَّبِّ.
verses.en: Notwithstanding, no devoted thing, that a man may devote unto the LORD of all that he hath, whether of man or beast, or of the field of his possession, shall be sold or redeemed; every devoted thing is most holy unto the LORD.
verses.kjv: Notwithstanding no devoted thing, that a man shall devote unto the LORD of all that he hath, [both] of man and beast, and of the field of his possession, shall be sold or redeemed: every devoted thing [is] most holy unto the LORD.
verses.web: “‘Notwithstanding, no devoted thing that a man devotes to Yahweh of all that he has, whether of man or animal, or of the field of his possession, shall be sold or redeemed. Everything that is permanently devoted is most holy to Yahweh.

verses.he: כָּל־חֵ֗רֶם אֲשֶׁ֧ר יָחֳרַ֛ם מִן־הָאָדָ֖ם לֹ֣א יִפָּדֶ֑ה מֹ֖ות יוּמָֽת׃
verses.ar: كُلُّ مُحَرَّمٍ يُحَرَّمُ مِنَ ٱلنَّاسِ لَا يُفْدَى. يُقْتَلُ قَتْلًا.
verses.en: None devoted, that may be devoted of men, shall be ransomed; he shall surely be put to death.
verses.kjv: None devoted, which shall be devoted of men, shall be redeemed; [but] shall surely be put to death.
verses.web: “‘No one devoted to destruction, who shall be devoted from among men, shall be ransomed. He shall surely be put to death.

verses.he: וְכָל־מַעְשַׂ֨ר הָאָ֜רֶץ מִזֶּ֤רַע הָאָ֙רֶץ֙ מִפְּרִ֣י הָעֵ֔ץ לַיהוָ֖ה ה֑וּא קֹ֖דֶשׁ לַֽיהוָֽה׃
verses.ar: «وَكُلُّ عُشْرِ ٱلْأَرْضِ مِنْ حُبُوبِ ٱلْأَرْضِ وَأَثْمَارِ ٱلشَّجَرِ فَهُوَ لِلرَّبِّ. قُدْسٌ لِلرَّبِّ.
verses.en: And all the tithe of the land, whether of the seed of the land, or of the fruit of the tree, is the LORD'S; it is holy unto the LORD.
verses.kjv: And all the tithe of the land, [whether] of the seed of the land, [or] of the fruit of the tree, [is] the LORD’s: [it is] holy unto the LORD.
verses.web: “‘All the tithe of the land, whether of the seed of the land or of the fruit of the trees, is Yahweh’s. It is holy to Yahweh.

verses.he: וְאִם־גָּאֹ֥ל יִגְאַ֛ל אִ֖ישׁ מִמַּֽעַשְׂרֹ֑ו חֲמִשִׁיתֹ֖ו יֹסֵ֥ף עָלָֽיו׃
verses.ar: وَإِنْ فَكَّ إِنْسَانٌ بَعْضَ عُشْرِهِ يَزِيدُ خُمْسَهُ عَلَيْهِ.
verses.en: And if a man will redeem aught of his tithe, he shall add unto it the fifth part thereof.
verses.kjv: And if a man will at all redeem [ought] of his tithes, he shall add thereto the fifth [part] thereof.
verses.web: If a man redeems anything of his tithe, he shall add a fifth part to it.

verses.he: וְכָל־מַעְשַׂ֤ר בָּקָר֙ וָצֹ֔אן כֹּ֥ל אֲשֶׁר־יַעֲבֹ֖ר תַּ֣חַת הַשָּׁ֑בֶט הֽ͏ָעֲשִׂירִ֕י יִֽהְיֶה־קֹּ֖דֶשׁ לַֽיהוָֽה׃
verses.ar: وَأَمَّا كُلُّ عُشْرِ ٱلْبَقَرِ وَٱلْغَنَمِ فَكُلُّ مَا يَعْبُرُ تَحْتَ ٱلْعَصَا يَكُونُ ٱلْعَاشِرُ قُدْسًا لِلرَّبِّ.
verses.en: And all the tithe of the herd or the flock, whatsoever passeth under the rod, the tenth shall be holy unto the LORD.
verses.kjv: And concerning the tithe of the herd, or of the flock, [even] of whatsoever passeth under the rod, the tenth shall be holy unto the LORD.
verses.web: All the tithe of the herds or the flocks, whatever passes under the rod, the tenth shall be holy to Yahweh.

verses.he: לֹ֧א יְבַקֵּ֛ר בֵּֽין־טֹ֥וב לָרַ֖ע וְלֹ֣א יְמִירֶ֑נּוּ וְאִם־הָמֵ֣ר יְמִירֶ֔נּוּ וְהָֽיָה־ה֧וּא וּתְמוּרָתֹ֛ו יִֽהְיֶה־קֹ֖דֶשׁ לֹ֥א יִגָּאֵֽל׃
verses.ar: لَا يُفْحَصُ أَجَيِّدٌ هُوَ أَمْ رَدِيءٌ، وَلَا يُبْدِلُهُ. وَإِنْ أَبْدَلَهُ يَكُونُ هُوَ وَبَدِيلُهُ قُدْسًا. لَا يُفَكُّ».
verses.en: He shall not inquire whether it be good or bad, neither shall he change it; and if he change it at all, then both it and that for which it is changed shall be holy; it shall not be redeemed.
verses.kjv: He shall not search whether it be good or bad, neither shall he change it: and if he change it at all, then both it and the change thereof shall be holy; it shall not be redeemed.
verses.web: He shall not examine whether it is good or bad, neither shall he exchange it. If he exchanges it at all, then both it and that for which it is exchanged shall be holy. It shall not be redeemed.’”

verses.he: אֵ֣לֶּה הַמִּצְוֹ֗ת אֲשֶׁ֨ר צִוָּ֧ה יְהוָ֛ה אֶת־מֹשֶׁ֖ה אֶל־בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל בְּהַ֖ר סִינָֽי׃
verses.ar: هَذِهِ هِيَ ٱلْوَصَايَا ٱلَّتِي أَوْصَى ٱلرَّبُّ بِهَا مُوسَى إِلَى بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ فِي جَبَلِ سِينَاءَ.
verses.en: These are the commandments, which the LORD commanded Moses for the children of Israel in mount Sinai.
verses.kjv: These [are] the commandments, which the LORD commanded Moses for the children of Israel in mount Sinai.
verses.web: These are the commandments which Yahweh commanded Moses for the children of Israel on Mount Sinai.
